candidate_relations.label: Myocardial Infarction with ST-segment elevation
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms acute MI (thrombotic occlusion of distal LCx, elevated troponin, ST-elevation pattern in inferior/posterior/lateral leads), so STEMI is a component of the full diagnosis. However, the benchmark reference specifically requires recognition of subacute LVFWR as the complicating event — evidenced by contrast in the myocardium and pericardial effusion on CTA, cardiogenic shock without arrhythmia or bleeding, and progressive hemodynamic deterioration. C001 captures only the parent MI without the rupture complication.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the underlying STEMI but omits the critical complication of subacute left ventricular free wall rupture, which is the defining diagnostic object requested

case_quality_flags: Benchmark requires composite diagnosis: STEMI (inferior-posterior-lateral, LCx territory) PLUS subacute LVFWR complication; candidates addressing only one component should be rated partial_parent_or_component
CTA finding of contrast in myocardium and pericardial effusion is pathognomonic for LVFWR and is the key discriminating feature
